title: Nemotron-Personas-Brazil: Co-Designed Data for Sovereign AI
tldr: NVIDIA, in collaboration with Brazil, announces Nemotron-Personas-Brazil, a co-designed dataset aimed at facilitating sovereign AI development tailored to local linguistic and cultural contexts. This initiative focuses on creating robust, ethically aligned data for training country-specific large language models.

title: How enterprises are building AI agents in 2026
tldr: This blog post explores the current landscape of enterprise AI agent development in 2026, detailing various architectural patterns and implementation strategies. It provides insights into how organizations are leveraging advanced LLM capabilities and agentic frameworks to automate complex workflows and integrate AI into business processes.

title: Building Skills for Claude Code: Automating your procedural knowledge
tldr: This technical guide focuses on developing and integrating custom skills into Claude Code, enabling the automation of procedural knowledge for complex tasks. It delves into the methodologies for defining and implementing domain-specific capabilities, thereby enhancing Claude's utility in specialized coding environments and applications.

title: Accelerating Diffusion Models with an Open, Plug-and-Play Offering
tldr: NVIDIA introduces a new open, plug-and-play offering designed to significantly accelerate the inference and training of diffusion models. This technical release provides optimized libraries and frameworks, allowing developers to integrate high-performance diffusion capabilities into their applications with reduced computational overhead.

title: UniRG: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning
tldr: Microsoft Research introduces UniRG, a system designed to scale medical imaging report generation using multimodal reinforcement learning. UniRG leverages visual and textual inputs to produce high-quality, clinically relevant reports, addressing challenges in data scarcity and human-in-the-loop feedback.

title: Architectural Choices in China's Open-Source AI Ecosystem: Building Beyond DeepSeek
tldr: This blog post explores the fundamental architectural choices shaping China's open-source AI ecosystem, particularly discussing developments and strategies beyond the influence of DeepSeek. It analyzes trends in model design, infrastructure, and community collaboration that are driving innovation in the region.

title: Rust at Scale: An Added Layer of Security for WhatsApp
tldr: Meta details the strategic integration of Rust at scale within WhatsApp to enhance security, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency features. This engineering decision fortifies critical infrastructure, which is foundational for large-scale applications including AI components.

title: Alyah ⭐️: Toward Robust Evaluation of Emirati Dialect Capabilities in Arabic LLMs
tldr: TII UAE introduces Alyah, a new benchmark suite designed for the robust evaluation of Emirati dialect capabilities within Arabic Large Language Models. This work addresses the critical need for fine-grained linguistic assessment, enabling more accurate and culturally relevant LLMs for specific regional nuances.

title: Unlocking Agentic RL Training for GPT-OSS: A Practical Retrospective
tldr: LinkedIn presents a practical retrospective on implementing agentic reinforcement learning training for open-source GPT models. The article delves into the challenges and successful strategies for developing and optimizing RL-driven agent behaviors, highlighting key lessons learned from real-world applications.

title: Introducing Prism
tldr: OpenAI has introduced "Prism," a new AI system designed to significantly enhance multimodal capabilities and advanced reasoning across diverse data types. This release marks a strategic expansion of their foundational model offerings, targeting improved performance in complex perception and generation tasks.

title: Adaptive Inference in NVIDIA TensorRT for RTX Enables Automatic Optimization
tldr: NVIDIA announces adaptive inference capabilities within TensorRT for RTX GPUs, enabling automatic optimization of AI models at runtime. This advancement dynamically adjusts model execution to maximize performance and efficiency across varying workloads and hardware configurations.

title: Build a serverless AI Gateway architecture with AWS AppSync Events
tldr: AWS details the construction of a serverless AI Gateway architecture utilizing AWS AppSync Events, focusing on scalable and efficient interaction patterns for AI services. The architecture aims to provide a robust and extensible front-end for various generative AI and machine learning applications.

title: How to Unlock Local Detail in Coarse Climate Projections with NVIDIA Earth-2
tldr: This NVIDIA blog details a technical approach within the Earth-2 platform to downscale coarse climate models, enabling the generation of high-resolution local weather and climate projections. It likely leverages AI/ML techniques for super-resolution or conditional generation to enhance predictive granularity and improve climate impact assessments.

title: Build AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using AWS CloudFormation
tldr: AWS demonstrates how to deploy AI agents built with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using AWS CloudFormation for infrastructure-as-code automation. This technical guide outlines the declarative provisioning of agent resources, streamlining the deployment and management of complex agentic AI systems.

title: How the Amazon.com Catalog Team built self-learning generative AI at scale with Amazon Bedrock
tldr: The Amazon.com Catalog Team details their engineering journey in building a self-learning generative AI system at scale using Amazon Bedrock. This blog post elucidates the architectural patterns, data pipelines, and continuous learning mechanisms employed to manage and generate vast amounts of catalog content efficiently.

title: Unrolling the Codex agent loop
tldr: OpenAI's latest engineering blog details the technical architecture and operational mechanics behind "unrolling the Codex agent loop." This post explores the iterative process and computational graph involved in autonomous code generation and execution, providing insights into improving the reliability and efficiency of AI agents.

title: How PDI built an enterprise-grade RAG system for AI applications with AWS
tldr: PDI outlines the technical blueprint and implementation challenges of constructing an enterprise-grade Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system for AI applications on AWS. The article details best practices for data indexing, retrieval optimization, and integration strategies to ensure scalable and accurate information synthesis for large language models.

title: Scaling PostgreSQL to power 800 million ChatGPT users
tldr: OpenAI has published an engineering deep-dive on scaling PostgreSQL to accommodate 800 million ChatGPT users. The article details the infrastructural challenges, architectural solutions, and database optimization strategies employed to manage massive user loads reliably and efficiently.
